resources.string: The feeds could not be reached. Check the TV\'s network connection and the feed addresses; the screensaver tries again in a couple of minutes.
Add an RSS or Atom feed in the screensaver\'s settings, or with setup.sh.
Use an https:// address, if you like after a name and a bar: Name | https://…
When the screensaver starts is set in the TV\'s own settings (Screensaver, or Energy saving), or with setup.sh. News is refreshed every 15 minutes while it shows.
